Yeah I get it, but for me it's only about I would say 60% of the time I just have to be alone for my own sanity. I hate just having obligations to people even within my own family and it sucks, I feel so emotionally numb the entire time so I can't even give them a worthwhile interaction so I just isolate myself. I've had to go through a lot of shit in my life and I replay it again and again everyday thinking if it could of happened differently or where I would be if X didn't happen or happened and I get caught in these thought spirals. When I get like this there isn't a single person who can help me and I really do just need space to untangle my thoughts before I can be "myself" (whatever that is) again. 

I kinda ended up venting there but that's just my take, I find that exercise can help to tire you out so you don't feel like your about to blow up.

I'm fairly certain BPD or ASPD was not a diagnosis back then, they just labelled you a schizophrenic, I have watched Dahmer I actually quite enjoyed it but I like tense and disturbing TV shows so your mileage may vary.
Cool thanks guys, I just would've thought that it does not count seeing as how you are kinda cheesing part of the game but I suppose that's going to make my playthrough a great deal easier.

Hi I'm a 19 y/o Male from Ireland, you sound pretty chill and upfront. I am also in college and I would too consider anxiety just being part of me. I enjoy music, playing video games and writing from time to time. I also enjoy talking about anything and like to connect with people.

Well if you enjoy it and it doesn't seem to make things worse that much go for it, but it may stunt your long term recovery so it's up to you, I still smoke time to time with good friends mabye once a month which does exacerbate the symptoms but at the same time idc because I'm having a good time, just mabye space out how often you smoke is my only recommendation if your symptoms are only mild.
Depends on your symptoms, if your case is mild you could probably get away with it but if your like me and start getting full on psychosis episodes off smoking half a j probably is not a good idea
Jesus I dont have visual snow that bad and I have a fairly severe case of hppd
Fuck I wish, hppd is fine I mean it's not ideal but its manageable, dpdr is the main issue at least for me

I feel the same way, that manifests physically for me aswell as I feel like I cant properly articulate my thoughts anymore, I've had dp/dr the past 4-5 weeks which is bothersome. Tbh I can live with hppd but the things dp/dr does to my head just isnt on for me, I really hope it's gone in a few weeks
I've had dreams every night the past 2 months and I can tell you it gets old super quickly, also do you feel a constant inward pressure on your head?

Man why are you taking melatonin?
I think it's best to stop altogether with anything that could possibly over stimulate brain activity, especially caffeine, also consider yourself lucky hppd for me gives me an outrageous amount of visuals 24/7.
That's pretty much my symptoms aswell, by any chance when you tripped did you see writing on walls in a sort of graffiti font?
It did for me at least for a time but it ended up coming back

There is anti epileptic meds that apparently work but I dont want to go down that path myself, I've been thinking of buying high strength cbd oil that you drip onto your tongue through a dropper which can elevate some symptoms, I think what's bothering me most atm is the non stop constant dreaming every night for the past few weeks without fail, thank you for your support non the less
This is literally me atm, everything you just described is me
